name: AI Deco
description: Select objects in the editor and prompt an AI to decorate them.

provider.name: AI Service
provider.description: Gemini, Groq and OpenRouter have free tiers (sign up for a free key, no payment). Ollama runs a model on your own PC for free, but is slow without a good GPU. Claude needs a paid Anthropic key.

free-api-key.name: API Key (Gemini / Groq / OpenRouter)
free-api-key.description: Free key for the selected service. Gemini: aistudio.google.com/apikey, Groq: console.groq.com, OpenRouter: openrouter.ai/keys. Stored in plain text in your Geode save folder.

free-model.name: Model Override
free-model.description: Leave empty for the default model of the selected service (Gemini: gemini-2.5-flash, Groq: openai/gpt-oss-120b, OpenRouter: openrouter/free, Ollama: qwen2.5:7b).

ollama-url.name: Ollama URL
ollama-url.description: Where Ollama is running. On Android, use your PC's local IP instead of localhost.

api-key.name: Claude API Key
api-key.description: Only used when AI Service is Claude. Paid key from console.anthropic.com. Stored in plain text in your Geode save folder.

model.name: Claude Model
model.description: Opus gives the best layouts. Sonnet and Haiku are faster and cheaper.

effort.name: Claude Effort
effort.description: How hard the model thinks. Lower is faster.

max-objects.name: Max Generated Objects
max-objects.description: Upper limit on objects created per generation.

max-context-objects.name: Max Selection Objects Sent
max-context-objects.description: How many selected objects are described to the AI. Bigger selections are truncated.

extra-palette.name: Extra Object IDs
extra-palette.description: Object IDs the AI may use besides those in your selection. Format: id:description, comma-separated. Example: 1764:small dot,211:black block
